description: This Java source file defines a class AttributesDeletedStrategy that handles AttributesDeleted events by removing all attributes from a thing builder. It is part of the strategies for processing thing events within a persistence context in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AttributesDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final, immutable class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle AttributesDeleted events by removing all attributes from a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process an AttributesDeleted event by invoking removeAllAttributes on the provided ThingBuilder from copy.
